q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The choir sang ________ during the Christmas service.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The choir sang ________ during the Christmas service.
solution:
Solution (EN): The blank requires an adverb to modify the verb 'sang'. 'Beautifully' is the correct adverb. 'Beautiful' is an adjective, 'beauty' is a noun, and 'beautify' is a verb.
Solution (HI): यहाँ क्रिया 'sang' की विशेषता बताने के लिए adverb (क्रिया विशेषण) की आवश्यकता है। 'Beautifully' सही adverb है। 'Beautiful' adjective है, 'beauty' noun है, और 'beautify' verb है।
Short Trick: Verb (sang) needs an Adverb (beautifully) to describe how the action was performed.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate preposition to fill in the blank.

Please leave the keys right ________ the table.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate preposition to fill in the blank.

Please leave the keys right ________ the table.
solution:
Solution (EN): The preposition 'on' is used to indicate that something is physically in contact with and supported by a surface.
Solution (HI): 'On' का उपयोग किसी सतह के संपर्क में और उसके ऊपर होने की स्थिति को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है। इसलिए यहाँ 'on' सही होगा।
Short Trick: Supported by a surface = 'on' (on the table).

q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. because of
B. the heavy rain
C. the match
D. was postponed
E. indefinitely
q_hi:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. because of
B. the heavy rain
C. the match
D. was postponed
E. indefinitely
solution:
Solution (EN): The logical sequence starts with the subject 'the match' (C), followed by the verb phrase 'was postponed' (D), the adverb 'indefinitely' (E), and the reason 'because of' (A) 'the heavy rain' (B). Correct order: CDEAB.
Solution (HI): तार्किक क्रम कर्ता 'the match' (C) से शुरू होता है, उसके बाद क्रिया 'was postponed' (D), फिर 'indefinitely' (E), और अंत में कारण 'because of' (A) 'the heavy rain' (B)। सही क्रम: CDEAB.
Short Trick: Find the main Subject (The match) and Verb (was postponed). C directly links to D.

q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

reading / a / is / habit / good
q_hi:

reading / a / is / habit / good
solution:
Solution (EN): The correct and most natural structure is Subject (Reading) + Verb (is) + Article (a) + Adjective (good) + Noun (habit).
Solution (HI): सही संरचना Subject (Reading) + Verb (is) + Article (a) + Adjective (good) + Noun (habit) है। विकल्प 1 व्याकरण की दृष्टि से एकदम सही है।
Short Trick: Identify the main subject 'Reading' and follow with the linking verb 'is'.

Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place where birds are kept
q_hi:

A place where birds are kept
solution:

Short Trick: Root word 'Aves' relates to birds, hence Aviary.

q_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A period of ten years
q_hi:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A period of ten years
solution:
Solution (EN): A 'Decade' is a period of ten years. A 'Century' is 100 years, a 'Millennium' is 1000 years, and a 'Fortnight' is a period of 14 days.
Solution (HI): दस वर्षों की अवधि को 'Decade' (दशक) कहा जाता है। 'Century' सौ वर्ष, 'Millennium' हज़ार वर्ष, और 'Fortnight' पखवाड़े (14 दिन) को कहते हैं।
Short Trick: The prefix 'Deca-' means ten.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abundant
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abundant
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Abundant' means existing or available in large quantities. 'Plentiful' is its exact synonym. 'Scarce', 'Rare', and 'Empty' are antonyms.
Solution (HI): 'Abundant' का अर्थ है प्रचुर मात्रा में या बहुतायत। 'Plentiful' इसका सही समानार्थी है। 'Scarce' (दुर्लभ) और 'Empty' (खाली) इसके विपरीत अर्थ देते हैं।
Short Trick: Abundant = A lot of something = Plentiful.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Diligent
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Diligent
solution:
Solution (EN): 'Diligent' means having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties (hardworking). Its antonym is 'Lazy', which means unwilling to work.
Solution (HI): 'Diligent' का अर्थ है परिश्रमी या मेहनती। इसका विलोम (antonym) 'Lazy' (आलसी) होगा। 'Hardworking' और 'Active' इसके समानार्थी (synonyms) हैं।
Short Trick: Diligent implies hard work. The exact opposite of hard work is lazy.

q_en:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Despite the poor conditions, he proved to be ______ honest man.
q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Despite the poor conditions, he proved to be ______ honest man.
solution:
Solution (EN): The word 'honest' begins with a consonant letter 'h' but is pronounced with a vowel sound ('o'). Therefore, the article 'an' must precede it.
Solution (HI): शब्द 'honest' व्यंजन (consonant) 'h' से शुरू होता है लेकिन इसका उच्चारण स्वर ध्वनि ('o') से होता है। इसलिए, इससे पहले 'an' का उपयोग किया जाएगा।
Short Trick: Always judge 'a' or 'an' by the sound, not the spelling. Honest starts with an 'O' sound.
